rules: Scheme by the fixed Lipper prefix table; a row maps to a fund class only when exactly one class in that scheme has an MPFA platform one-year cumulative return equal to the Lipper one-year % Growth on the same date AND every word of the Lipper fund name (after the fixed abbreviation table) appears in that class's English fund and class name. Classes Lipper does not list stay unmapped (never borrowed from another class).
